Date: Mon, 8 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoicing cadence question for Q1 pilot

Hi Lauren,

Quick one on our end — the finance team has asked whether we can move the pilot invoices to a staggered remit over a 60-day horizon instead of the standard Net30. This is primarily cashflow smoothing for their fiscal quarter close (Jan). They want something like: 30% on pilot kickoff invoice, 40% on mid-pilot milestone, 30% on completion — with VAT charged to the billing entity in the UK and the US entity covering service fees.

Do you have flexibility on payment terms or a conditional credit buffer? If so, can you send a short proposed calendar and any VAT mapping you need from our side? We need to present this to procurement tomorrow morning.

Appreciate it —
Natalie
Natalie Rhodes
Director, Strategic Ops — Medify Health
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Natalie Rhodes <natalie.rhodes@medifyhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Dec 2025 12:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Remit splay / invoice horizon proposal

Hi Natalie —

Thanks for the context and the proposed split. We can be flexible for a pilot; below is a proposal that balances Redwood's DSO expectations and Medify's quarter-close needs. I attached a one-page calendar (Remit_Horizon_v1.xlsx) and a VAT entity mapping template (VAT_entity_map.pdf) — if you can populate the VAT fields and return, that'll speed approvals.

Proposed pilot remit (conditional & subject to credit review):
- Invoice A (Kickoff): 30% due Net30 from issuance
- Invoice B (Mid-pilot milestone): 40% due Net45 from issuance of milestone invoice
- Invoice C (Completion): 30% due Net60 from completion invoice

Conditional credit buffer:
- We will permit the extended Net45/Net60 on Invoice B and C provided Medify supplies:
  1) Completed VAT_entity_map.pdf with entity tax IDs and VAT registration evidence
  2) Signed SOW and PO referencing the staggered payment schedule
  3) A credit card on file or a letter of credit up to 20% of the pilot ARR as contingency

VAT handling recommendation:
- Redwood invoices the service portion from Redwood US (EIN...) for US-recognized services and Redwood UK for VAT-liable items where Medify's UK entity is the buyer. If Medify confirms a single billing entity, we'll route VAT accordingly and include VAT line items.

Next steps (quick):
1) Natalie — confirm the split and share completed VAT_entity_map.pdf by EOD 12/09
2) Marissa / Rishi — please run a conditional credit check and confirm the contingency amount and any additional underwriting notes
3) If all good, I will issue the kickoff invoice and the PO/SOW will reflect the staggered schedule

Happy to hop on a 15-min call if that helps.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Date: Tue, 9 Dec 2025 10:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Remit splay / invoice horizon proposal

Lauren — quick underwriting notes after a first pass:

1) Credit check: Medify has a clean payment history with Redwood (pilot volume < $60k). Given the pilot size, underwriting is comfortable with a 20% contingency held/charged to the CC on file if Invoice B/C aging extends beyond Net60.

2) VAT risk: need populated VAT_entity_map.pdf showing which legal entity signs the PO. If the UK entity is the buyer, VAT is applicable on the invoice and we'll need their VAT registration number and fiscal code.

3) Suggested addition to SOW: include a fallback clause that moves Invoice B to Net30 if milestone delivery is delayed more than 10 business days to avoid open exposure.

If you want, I can draft the short SOW amendment and the underwriting clause — should be a one-paragraph addendum.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Finance Director, Redwood Inference

Lauren / Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear checklist. We reviewed internally and can proceed under the proposed conditional schedule. Action items on our side:
- James will populate VAT_entity_map.pdf and return by EOD 12/11
- Procurement will sign the SOW addendum referencing the staged remit and contingency clause
- AP will provision a corporate card for the 20% contingency (ap@medifyhealth.com)

We appreciate the fallback clause — that should be fine. Please send the SOW amendment and we'll sign. Once we have the completed map, I'll confirm and request kickoff.

Best,
Natalie
